resources.string: Material presets, fine-tuning and rendering for classic Explore source rows
Shares the exact Solid / Glass / Frosted glass presets with the bottom bar; the sliders below fine-tune those preset values
Following the bottom bar material (%1$s); turn off Follow bottom bar to choose a style here
Uses the bottom bar preset verbatim, including its strength; the style and strength here are ignored. Solid maps to No glass
Same setting as Explore glass in theme editing, stored separately for day and night; 0 turns the glass off (No glass style is unaffected)
Following the bottom bar material: strength also comes from the bottom bar. Turn off Follow bottom bar to adjust it here
100 keeps the bottom bar preset value, 0 is weakest, 200 doubles it; applies to both hardware Gaussian and software blur
100 keeps the bottom bar shell gradient; higher values separate text from the wallpaper more strongly
100 keeps the bottom bar tint value; higher values make the glass surface brighter
100 keeps the bottom bar stroke value; higher values make the outline clearer
Available on Android 12 and above; disabling forces the verified software blur fallback
When enabled, animated wallpapers are not sampled as a still first frame; disable it to accept a static glass frame
Clears every setting on this page, including the material style and day / night glass strength

string-array.name: explore_glass_mode_descriptions
string-array.item: Matches the bottom bar Solid style: source rows use the same solid shell, with no glass layer; e-ink and low-memory devices still fall back to the plain background
Matches the bottom bar Glass style: 8 + level x 10dp light blur, 0.02 + level x 0.05 faint tint, stronger dispersion/refraction and a brighter edge highlight
Matches the bottom bar Frosted glass style: 12 + level x 18dp blur, 0.05 + level x 0.10 tint, with the same shell and stroke alphas
